name: Rule unification: delete legacy rules and rewrite scaffold (B3)
description:
**Repo: this repo (**`shoptet-partner-cli`). Depends on the previous B1+B2 task (deletion must never leave `validate` linting nothing). Source of truth: `doc/plans/rule-unification-b3.md`.

## What gets deleted

- `packages/eslint-config` — `shoptet/no-load-order-globals` (with its ~120-entry `KNOWN_WINDOW_GLOBALS` list) and `shoptet/datalayer-schema`, plus `ruleDocUrl`, `no-var`, `no-implicit-globals`, `no-global-assign`.
- `packages/stylelint-config` — the 5 stock-rule config (`selector-max-combinators`, `selector-max-type`, `selector-max-universal`, `selector-max-specificity`, `selector-no-qualifying-type`).
- `packages/stylelint-plugin-fragile-selectors` — `shoptet/selector-no-universal-child-combinator`, `shoptet/selector-no-positional-nth-child`.
- Subpath exports `packages/cli/src/eslint-config.ts` and `src/stylelint-config.ts` (and their `tsdown.config.ts` entries and `packages/cli/package.json` `./eslint-config` / `./stylelint-config` exports).

## Capability lost — must be recorded in the ADR

`shoptet/datalayer-schema` has no replacement in the config repo's rule set: it validated `dataLayer` pushes for `unknownField`, `unguardedOptionalAccess`, `invalidPageType`, `schemaUnavailable`. Say this plainly in the ADR, per this repo's "never document an unimplemented capability as if it works" rule.

## Scaffold rewrite

`packages/create/src/templates.ts` currently writes `import shoptetConfig from "shoptet/eslint-config"` and a `.stylelintrc` extending `"shoptet/stylelint-config"`. Both retarget to `@shoptet/addon-eslint-config` / `@shoptet/addon-stylelint-config`, added to generated `devDependencies` via `packages/create/src/package-json.ts` — **with a caret** (the one deliberately caret spot in the whole track; every gatekeeper pin stays exact).

## Follow-on cleanup

- Amend ADR 0062 (`selectorSpecificityIdCaveat` — dead once its target rule is gone).
- Remove `ruleDocUrl` and the `https://developers.shoptet.com/cli/lint/{eslint,stylelint}/…` URL scheme.
- Retarget or delete `.claude/skills/lint-rule-authoring`.
- Decide on the now-orphaned `"datalayer"` value in `Diagnostic.source`.
- Adjust `vitest.config.ts` coverage entries for the deleted packages.
- Fix the stale `doc/overview.md` `deps.alwaysBundle` claim (actual config is `deps: { onlyBundle: ["@shoptet/*"] }`).

## Definition of done

`validate`'s observable behaviour is unchanged by this slice (proves B1/B2 already fully wired the shared rules before anything old is deleted). Perturbation check: deleting a shared package from `node_modules` must fail loudly. Grep the whole tree (incl. `.claude/`, `doc/`, fixtures) for `no-load-order-globals`, `datalayer-schema`, `fragile-selectors`, `shoptet/eslint-config`, `shoptet/stylelint-config` — nothing should remain outside history.
